items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: the name of the picture was Breakfast at Sunrise, at Universal, and the star was Constance Talmadge.

ctx.x: Indeed a legend, Mr. Satchel McVea.

I was on one job out there with him, the name of the picture was Breakfast at Sunrise, at Universal, and the star was Constance Talmadge. In those days musicians would actually play to entertain the stars while they were acting.
